description: When the status write gets no answer, the task panel's error heading is the raw browser string "Failed to fetch".
expected: "Couldn't reach your local Pardner client. Your change is saved in this tab; retry when it is back."
actual: "Failed to fetch" / "Your last confirmed data remains available." / Retry saved request.
suggested_fix: Map network TypeErrors to the CLIENT_UNREACHABLE copy used elsewhere.

criterion: Feedback: user knows what is pending
description: Neither the board banner "A request is awaiting confirmation." nor the switcher suffix says WHICH change is pending, and the Status select reverts to its old value, so the attempted change (Rotate API keys -> In progress) is invisible.
expected: Banner names the change: "Moving Rotate API keys to In progress is awaiting confirmation." and the card shows a pending marker.
actual: Generic banner; card stays in its old column with no marker; New task is disabled with no reason on the button.
suggested_fix: Store a human summary with the pending record and render it in the banner and on the affected card.

description: The switcher item reads "Saved locally · synced · unconfirmed change" and the header reads "Saved locally · synced" while a write is unconfirmed. "synced" and "unconfirmed" contradict each other; the suffix also wraps the item onto three lines.
expected: A single state, e.g. "1 change not confirmed", replacing "synced" for that project.
actual: Both labels at once; header never reflects the pending write.
suggested_fix: Let the pending marker override the sync label in both the switcher and SaveStatus.

description: A second tab on the same project shows no marker and no banner, although the first tab still holds the unconfirmed change.
expected: Pending state is visible from any tab of the same browser, or the banner explains it is held in another tab.
actual: Second tab: switcher "Checkout rewrite — Saved locally · synced", no banner.
suggested_fix: Keep pending records in localStorage keyed by tab, and surface other tabs' pending changes read-only.
